title: Transmon Architecture for Emission and Detection of Single Microwave Photons
summary: We develop a compact transmon emitter/detector (TED) superconducting circuit and demonstrate its dual functionality as a single-photon source and detector. In our setup, photons emitted by a source TED are transmitted via a meter-long coaxial cable, routed through a circulator, and captured by a measurement TED. Both TED modules operate with nominally identical parameters, highlighting the flexibility of this novel architecture.
